g.title: legend
g.text: Solid arrows: control / permission / labeled two-way exchange. Dashed arrows: evidence.
Vehicle snapshot also feeds HLC (HSA-IF-007; connector omitted).
Arrows summarize contracts; labels are semantic direction, not generated P/R ports.
Stop responsibility: DENY → request safe hardware → coordinate HLC / PLC teardown.
HLC has no direct actuator command path. Electrical sequencing needs the vehicle safety concept.
